Q: What does the mysqli version mean? A:

MySQLi is a PHP extension. The version of the mysqli extension will always be the same as the PHP version. However, mysqli is just a wrapper for the driver that connects to your database. In the past, it was possible to connect either with the original C MySQL library or with PHP's version of it called mysqlnd.

The mysqlnd library is coupled with PHP, so it will have the same version number as PHP. But if you used an older PHP version and mysqli was compiled with the libmysqlclient then the version would have been whatever the MySQL library version is, which could be 5.5.30 in your case. Since PHP 8.2, it's no longer possible to compile mysqli with anything other than mysqlnd.

Q: Indent / pad text in TextEditor A:

Starting iOS 17 / macOS 14 you can use `contentMargins(_:for:)`

I understand the question is asking about iOS 15, but posting this in case anyone else's is struggling with the same situation.

https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swiftui/view/contentmargins(_:for:)

Example

TextEditor(text: $text)
    .contentMargins(.horizontal, 20.0, for: .scrollContent)

Q: lazy loading layouts like `vue-router` does with components A:

Router treats component function in a special way, you should handle it yourself to provide suitable layout value. Likely should be computed(() => defineAsyncComponent(() => import(...)))
